Mélenchon replied that he couldn't be disappointed because he never asked to go: "They're banning me from entering a territory I didn't ask to enter."

📌 Tehran, IRNA — The Iranian Army Navy has announced that two more oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines as they were entering a prohibited zone, east of the Strait of Hormuz.

In a statement on Thursday afternoon, the Navy said the two offending vessels had disregarded the repeated warnings and deactivated their radar systems as they tried to pass through unsafe zones east of the strait, where they struck a naval mine and subsequently engulfed in flames.
​
The statement emphasized that responsibility for the fires lies, first and foremost, with the “lying US President,” and secondly with the owners of the vessels who placed their trust in his false, fear-mongering rhetoric, a reference to Donald Trump.
​
Iranian officials have repeatedly cautioned commercial vessels against using routes designated by Tehran as unauthorized and unsafe, stressing the need to comply with its maritime coordination requirements.
